Reich ( / r aɪ k , r aɪ x / ryke, raikh ; [ 1 ] [ 2 ] German: [ʁaɪç] ⓘ ) is a German word whose meaning is analogous to the English word " realm ". [ a ] The terms Kaiserreich [ b ] and Königreich [ c ] are respectively used in German in reference to empires and kingdoms .  In English usage, the term " the Reich" often refers to Nazi Germany , also called "the Third Reich". [ 2 ]
